notes.title: 🎉 The Demo Is Now LIVE! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re super excited to announce that the demo for [b]Hexbound [/b] is now available to play! 🧩✨

This is your chance to get a hands-on feel for the game, try out some of the core mechanics, and explore the world I’ve been building with care.

What’s in the demo: 
🔸 Chapter 1 of the story.
🔸 3 Boxes with 4 boards to play in each one. 
🔸 Beautiful image puzzles (Box 2 and 3)

We'd love to hear your feedback, thoughts, and impressions. Feel free to share them in the Steam Discussions or through the feedback form in the game. 

Your feedback is incredibly valuable as I continue development toward the full release. ❤️

👉 Click ‘Download Demo’ to jump in!
And if you enjoy it, don’t forget to Wishlist the game – it helps a ton!

Thanks for being here with us from the start,
– Lorant, Sirius Gaming Studio

notes.title: Demo Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm excited to share some great news—the demo for our cosy hexagonal puzzle game is coming very soon! I carefully crafted this demo to give you a taste of what's to come, featuring:

[list]
[*] Engaging puzzles set in a warm, inviting environment.
[*] Unique boards designed to challenge and relax your mind.
[*] A glimpse into the story through heartfelt letters from your distant friend.
[/list]

My goal is to create a calming yet intriguing puzzle experience, and your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the full game.

Stay tuned for more details, and be sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. I can't wait for you to try it!
